nodes.title: 📦 BASE MODELS THIS EXPECTS
widgets_values:
* unet    (acestep_v1.5_xl_sft_bf16.safetensors)
* clip 1  (qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors)
* clip 2  (qwen_4b_ace15.safetensors)
* vae     (ace_1.5_vae.safetensors)


📝 WHY THE PROMPT AND LYRICS SIT IN THEIR OWN NODE
--------------------------------------------------

A Madow profile saves the COMPLETE input set - prompt and lyrics
included. So loading a different profile to try another key scale or a
different sampler character overwrites Madow's prompt and lyrics with
that profile's own. Holding them in the Prompt and Lyrics node keeps the
song you are testing fixed across every profile you switch to, so you
are comparing settings against the same material instead of against a
moving target. Edit the song there, not in Madow.


📝 THE PROMPT AND LYRICS ARE THE LoRA'S OWN
-------------------------------------------

Both are what this LoRA was trained around, so treat them as a
known-good starting point rather than a demo. Change them gradually: the
further the prompt drifts from the trained style, the less the LoRA
contributes. strength_model is 1.00, full strength - pull it toward
0.6-0.8 to let more of the base model through.


🎛️ THE SAMPLER SETTINGS LIVE IN THE MADOW PRESET
------------------------------------------------

"Eb minor 14 gradient_estimation beta aggressive" carries steps, cfg,
sampler, scheduler, the APG values and the LM settings as one set. To
try a different character, switch preset rather than nudging individual
widgets - and Save As a new name instead of overwriting this one, so the
template still loads the way it shipped.


🎹 KEEP KEY AND TEMPO HONEST
----------------------------

music_keyscale (Eb minor) and music_bpm (98) are given to the model
directly. Rewrite the prompt to something faster or in another key and
these must change with it, or the two instructions pull apart.

music_duration is 300 s. Longer takes cost proportionally more time and
VRAM. The VAE decode is tiled (tile_size 256, overlap 32), which is what
keeps a five-minute decode inside sane memory.


🎲 SEED
-------

Nova Seed is set to randomize, so every run is a different take. To get
one back, set control_before_generate to fixed and paste the seed in.
Madow's context output records what produced a take, so the seed travels
with the generation rather than living only on the node.


🔊 OUTPUT
---------

file_folder / file_prefix / file_name / file_separator build the saved
name - here Ace_Step_XL_SFT_Generations and Nova_Two_Sets_of_Keys. Nova
Player reads "no audio connected - press play for a demo" until the
graph runs; the generated take then replaces the demo.

nodes.title: 🎼 ACE-STEP XL SFT - PROMPT AND LYRICS TO AUDIO Using LoRA
widgets_values:
Generates a song from a written prompt and a lyric sheet, using an
Ace-Step 1.5 XL SFT checkpoint with a style LoRA on top.

⚠️ DOWNLOAD THE LoRA FIRST - IT IS NOT PART OF THE PACK ⚠️

Southern_Blues_Rock.safetensors

https://github.com/NovaFemme/ComfyUI-NovaAudioPlayer/releases/download/assets-v1/Southern_Blues_Rock.safetensors


* Put it in:  (ComfyUI/models/loras/Ace-Step 1.5 XL SFT/)
* Verify it:  (sha256sum Southern_Blues_Rock.safetensors)
* Expected:   (e3226f560b781589cd637f984dd791da0fa7dc5dc4fd9bec177bde005faddc30)

The sub-folder is part of the setting. lora_name reads "Ace-Step 1.5 XL SFT/Southern_Blues_Rock.safetensors" - if the widget shows red, the file is not where the node is looking.

[Intro - Whispered Vocals & Synth Pulse]

Blue light under the doorway.
Phone screen glowing at 2 AM.
One message.
No reply.

(Wait...)

Then the whole room changes.

[Verse 1 - Smooth Female Vocal]

Rain beads on the taxi glass,
street signs smear as we move past.
Your reflection cuts through mine,
two silhouettes between the lines.

Neon spills across your sleeve,
like a secret neither one can leave.
You tap twice against the door,
then disappear into the crowd.

[Pre-Chorus - Rising Harmonies]

I hear the bass through concrete.
Three floors down, the ceiling shakes.
You look back for half a second.

That's all it takes.

[Chorus - Massive K-Pop Metal Drop]

GLASS VOLTAGE,
running underneath my skin.

One touch,
and the room goes thin.

GLASS VOLTAGE,
watch the skyline bend and blur.

No warning.
No permission.

I know exactly what we are.

[Post-Chorus - Group Chant]

Ah-ah,
DON'T LOOK BACK.

Ah-ah,
KEEP IT LIKE THAT.

Glass voltage.
Glass voltage.

[Verse 2 - Rhythmic Rap / Vocal Switch]

Black boots on the marble.
Click, click — never off tempo.

Red light catches on the buckle.
Whole room freezes when I enter.

No speech.
No pose.
No borrowed attitude.

I don't need the spotlight.
It follows what I do.

[Pre-Chorus - Vocal Build]

The elevator climbs.
Numbers disappear.

Bass through the metal walls.
Now you're standing here.

[Chorus - Full Impact]

GLASS VOLTAGE,
running underneath my skin.

One touch,
and the room goes thin.

GLASS VOLTAGE,
watch the skyline bend and blur.

No warning.
No permission.

I know exactly what we are.

[Instrumental Drop - Metal Guitar + Synth]

Heavy guitar riff.
Sharp synth stabs.
Punchy electronic drums.
Short technical guitar lead.

[Half-Time Bridge - Dark]

Slow down.

Watch the city through the rain.

Red tail lights
draw a line across the window.

Your hand on the glass.

Mine almost there.

Almost.

[Build - Layered Female Vocals]

One step.
Two steps.

Bass underneath.

Lights go out.

Hold your breath.

Now—

[Action Break - Double-Time]

MOVE!

Electric rhythm.
Rapid drums.
Distorted guitar runs.

No hesitation.
No rewind.

[Rap Section - Aggressive / Rhythmic]

Switch lanes.
Cut through.
New frame.
New view.

No map.
No signal.
Still I know what to do.

You thought I came this far
just to stand in the blue?

Watch the whole skyline
change its point of view.

[Pre-Chorus - Soaring Vocal]

I hear the glass begin to crack.
Not broken.

Just enough to let the night come through.

[Final Chorus - Huge]

GLASS VOLTAGE,
running underneath my skin.

One touch,
and the room goes thin.

GLASS VOLTAGE,
every window catches silver.

No warning.
No permission.

Now the whole city knows we're here.

[Final Drop - Group Vocals + Shred]

GLASS!
VOLTAGE!

HEY!

GLASS!
VOLTAGE!

HEY!

Heavy guitar riff.
Layered group chants.
Synth bass.
Explosive drums.

[Guitar Solo - Technical]

Melodic opening phrase.
Fast alternate picking.
Tapping sequence.
Wide bends.
Harmonized lead.
Long sustained final note.

[Outro - Atmospheric]

The rain stops.

The taxi pulls away.

One red light
remains on the glass.

(softly)

Still glowing.
